title: Cat Falls Into Pool After Bird Startles Them
description: This rescued Southern Caracara named Guali, who chose to stay near the property after being released, developed a habit of teasing the resident cats. The soaked cat quickly jumped out and ran away, while Guali remained calm as if nothing had happened.
